title: Hybrid neural-symbolic GNN — GraphSAGE link-prediction over system-viz
description: Adds a 5th tier to the existing 4-tier wiring-inference cascade (keyword → expanded-keyword → sibling-prefix → LLM): a GraphSAGE link-prediction GNN trained on learned node embeddings (768-d nomic-embed semantic + 128-d node2vec structural + 8-d SystemViz topology + node-kind one-hot). Strictly additive — hybrid (4-tier) remains the always-on baseline; GNN gate activates only when confidence >= PRISM_NNG_MIN_CONF (default 0.7). Recursive-self-improvement property: new engines/scripts/wiki entries become NEW NODES in system-graph.json via engine-node-extractor (shipped in U1), so the next training run sees the system reasoning about itself. v3 plan integrates ALL P0+P1 findings from the 4-agent scrutiny round (architecture / training-rigor / risk / wiring). See H:/.claude/plans/steady-kindling-tide.md for full design.
goals: Sub-millisecond, deterministic, calibrated-probability dispatcher predictions for unwired engines via GraphSAGE link prediction
Compose over existing infrastructure: OllamaEmbedderEngine (768-d nomic), KnowledgeGraphFeatureProjector pattern (8-d SystemViz topology version), wiki's _embeddings.jsonl (14,738 reusable vectors)
Bench-graded honest A/B vs LLM and hybrid on a 200-engine inductive holdout — per-confidence-bucket winner-takes-bucket policy
Recursive property: new engines/scripts become discrete nodes in system-graph.json (via U1's engine-node-extractor), so the GNN can reason about itself on next training run
Hybrid is the floor, GNN is the ceiling. Never replace; only augment. PRISM_NNG_DISABLE=1 reverts to today's behavior exactly.
